name: fallen dry young oak tree
description: a young, fallen, dry tree with light gray, scaly bark
details: A young tree thrown down and torn out of the ground, lying its full length along the ground with a ragged plate of roots and packed earth standing on end where the trunk leaves the soil.  Its bark is light gray and scaly with shallow fissures.  It carries no leaves, having been dead long enough that they have browned and fallen, and they lie scattered beneath it, oblong and seven-lobed.  The seasoned wood is dry, the bark loosening from it, and checks run out from the heart toward the bark.
